title: NDF Envelope v1.0.0
description: NDF envelope structure — produced after NDF-core finalisation. Not signed; contains signatures over NDF-core, timestamps, validation material, and operational fields. Each entry in 'assinaturas' is a self-contained unit of proof: timestamps and validation_material live per signature, not globally, so that N independent signatures (distinct certificates, chains, revocation data, signing instants) are never ambiguous about which proof belongs to which signature. Document succession is NOT represented here — it is a signed relation in NDF-core.relacoes (tipo 'substitui'), see SPEC.md §6 and ADR-011.

estado.description: Current archival lifecycle state, managed by the custodian system. Reflects the document's operational state, which may differ from the NDF-core's 'estado' (always 'ativo'). See SPEC.md §2.4.1.

validation_code.description: Canonical verification code. Derived as: 'NDF-' + BASE32_NOPAD(SHA-256(ndf_id + '|' + payload_hash))[:20]. Always present.

payload_hash.description: Digest of payload_bytes (JCS-canonicalised NDF-core), hex-encoded. Format: '<alg>:<hex>', algorithm-agnostic. Normative value for NDF v1.x is always 'sha256:' + 64 hex chars (payload_hash_alg, SPEC.md §2.5) — the pattern is intentionally broader than the current single algorithm so it does not need to change again when multi-algorithm support (roadmap 1.2.0) lands.

assinaturas.description: Assinaturas pessoais ou selos institucionais CAdES-B-LTA detached sobre payload_bytes. Assinatura pessoal obrigatória quando nivel_assinatura é avancada/qualificada; selo opcional quando é nenhuma.

assinatura_id.description: Stable identifier of this signature entry within the envelope. Enables unambiguous reference (e.g. from a future re-sealing/custody event) even when multiple signatures are present.

nivel.description: Tipo/nível da prova. Selo institucional não é assinatura pessoal.

papel.description: Administrative role exercised by this signatory on this specific document — distinct from 'signatario.cargo' (organisational job title) and from NDF-core.participantes (SPEC.md §2.12), which records participation independent of signing.

ordem.description: Optional sequence/ordering hint among co-signatures (e.g. co-authorship order). Descriptive only — this specification does not model signing workflow, quorum, or approval state machines.

nome.description: Common name from the signing certificate.

cargo.description: Organisational job title of the signatory (optional, from certificate or metadata). Not the same as 'papel' — a person's cargo may be 'Diretor de Serviços' while their papel on this document is 'decisor'.

cades_b_lta.description: DER-encoded detached CAdES-B-LTA signature (CMS/PKCS#7, ASN.1) over payload_bytes; its message digest matches payload_hash.

timestamps.description: RFC 3161 timestamps for this specific signature. Required when nivel ∈ {avancada, qualificada}.

validation_material.description: Certificate chain and revocation data captured at signing time, for this specific signature. Required when nivel ∈ {avancada, qualificada}.

assinatura.description: CAdES-B-T: RFC 3161 timestamp over the signature value.

arquivo.description: CAdES-B-LTA: RFC 3161 archive timestamp over signature + validation_material.
